skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic knowledge of data querying, database design; understand and apply basic principles of the data management application development process.

Design and build databases according to standard normalization forms. Implement simple problems through database querying languages such as relational algebra, SQL, etc. Think about query optimization methods. Approach different database models. Analyze, advise, and support the digital transformation process in data digitization.
Work independently or actively and effectively in group activities. Organize group activities. Have social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of Information Management Systems.
Understand and use basic Microsoft SQL Server.
Analyze, synthesize data to support decision-making processes.
Identify issues in businesses, determine input data, output information, and processing tools.
Apply critical thinking to optimize queries and ensure data integrity.
Manage and execute accounting software projects, analyze results.
Present effectively in groups, manage time, interact well with the audience.
